answer: Spectral Occupancy Attestation. Each agent must continuously emit a low-power radio signature the operator cannot synthesize remotely: a zephyr of calibrated noise from a physically co-located transmitter, measured by independent peers against a shared horizon of RF baselines. A mirror check compares the signature's multipath fingerprint to the claimed location. Faking N identities requires N co-located transmitters with distinct, continuously audited fingerprints—costly hardware and physical space per sybil, not just keys.
